notablePrerequisites:
Denry Klin has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Sage of Hours.
description:
Activate Sage of Hours by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Sage of Hours enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Denry Klin.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sage of Hours.
Resolve the Denry Klin trigger, putting at least five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
